principle: A pattern candidate is a queue item for stronger models, not a conclusion.

cohorts.cohort_policy: Pulotu cultural-tradition profiles using explicit PRESENT mappings only.

null_model.test: one-sided hypergeometric enrichment with fixed feature marginals
null_model.interpretation: Screens for surprising co-occurrence under naive fixed marginals only. It is not a causal, ancestral, diffusion, or independence test.

cohorts.cohort_policy: DRH RELIGIOUS_GROUP entries only; heterogeneous historical scopes remain separate upstream and aggregate presence is discovery-only.

null_model.test: one-sided hypergeometric enrichment with fixed feature marginals
null_model.interpretation: Screens for surprising co-occurrence under naive fixed marginals only. It is not a causal, ancestral, diffusion, or independence test.

cross_cohort_rule: Never pool Pulotu and DRH into one statistical sample without an explicit harmonized cohort design.
next_required_models: historical event-time model where dates permit
